BackstoryDef.title: coastal village child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a small coastal settlement, gathering shellfish from the shore, helping dry the catch, and mending fishing nets.

BackstoryDef.title: irrigation village child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside the channels that supplied the village fields, helping clear silt, watch the water flow, and repair small levees.

BackstoryDef.title: coastal fisher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the nearshore waters, tending nets, maintaining fishing gear, and preserving part of the catch by drying it. The work demanded patience and familiarity with changing coastal conditions.

BackstoryDef.title: irrigation caretaker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] helped maintain the channels bringing water to village fields, clearing ditches and repairing their banks. Sharing scarce water also required discussion with neighboring farmers.
